entities.title: Live, Attenuated, Tetravalent Butantan-Dengue Vaccine in Children and Adults
entities.summary: A single-dose, Brazilian-made dengue vaccine protected most recipients regardless of prior dengue exposure, offering an affordable option for the low- and middle-income countries hit hardest by dengue.
entities.journal: The New England journal of medicine

entities.title: CRISPR-Cas9 In Vivo Gene Editing of KLKB1 for Hereditary Angioedema
entities.summary: The first in-body CRISPR gene-editing treatment to durably silence a disease gene in adults with hereditary angioedema, cutting attack rates without repeat dosing.
entities.journal: The New England journal of medicine

institution.name: Auckland City Hospital, Department of Immunology

entities.title: Safety and efficacy of malaria vaccine candidate R21/Matrix-M in African children: a multicentre, double-blind, randomised, phase 3 trial
entities.summary: Large-scale African trial data showing a low-cost, easy-to-manufacture malaria vaccine protects young children, paving the way for its rollout across malaria-endemic countries.

entities.title: AI-enabled electrocardiography alert intervention and all-cause mortality: a pragmatic randomized clinical trial
entities.summary: A hospital-wide randomized trial in Taiwan found that an AI alert flagging high-risk ECGs and prompting doctors to act lowered patient deaths, showing AI screening can save lives in routine care.

institution.name: Tri-Service General Hospital, National Defense Medical Center

entities.title: A Novel Anti-CD38 Monoclonal Antibody for Treating Immune Thrombocytopenia
entities.summary: A newly designed antibody that clears antibody-producing plasma cells gave lasting platelet recovery to patients with treatment-resistant immune thrombocytopenia in a Chinese trial.
entities.journal: The New England journal of medicine

institution.name: Institute of Hematology & Blood Diseases Hospital, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences

entities.title: Twice-Yearly Lenacapavir or Daily F/TAF for HIV Prevention in Cisgender Women
entities.summary: A twice-yearly injection tested in thousands of young African women nearly eliminated new HIV infections, offering a long-acting prevention option where daily pills are hard to sustain.
entities.journal: The New England journal of medicine

institution.name: Desmond Tutu HIV Centre, University of Cape Town

entities.title: Antisense oligonucleotide therapy in an individual with KIF1A-associated neurological disorder
entities.summary: Doctors designed and manufactured a custom antisense drug for a single child with a rare, severe genetic brain disorder, showing personalized gene-silencing medicine can be made fast enough to help one patient.

institution.name: Department of Pediatrics, Columbia University Irving Medical Center

entities.title: An Accurate and Rapidly Calibrating Speech Neuroprosthesis
entities.summary: A brain implant decoded intended speech from a paralyzed patient with unprecedented accuracy and near-instant calibration, a major step toward restoring natural communication after paralysis.
entities.journal: The New England journal of medicine

institution.name: Department of Neurological Surgery, University of California, Davis

entities.title: Semaglutide and cardiovascular outcomes in patients with obesity and prevalent heart failure: a prespecified analysis of the SELECT trial
entities.summary: Follow-up analysis of a major obesity trial found semaglutide also lowered cardiovascular events in people who already had heart failure, widening the drug's proven benefits beyond weight loss.

institution.name: Institute of Cardiovascular Sciences, University College London

entities.title: Induced pluripotent stem-cell-derived corneal epithelium for transplant surgery: a single-arm, open-label, first-in-human interventional study in Japan
entities.summary: Japanese surgeons transplanted corneal tissue grown from a patient's own reprogrammed stem cells to restore sight, avoiding the need for scarce donor corneas or immune-suppressing drugs.

institution.name: Department of Ophthalmology, Osaka University Graduate School of Medicine

entities.title: Twice-Yearly Lenacapavir for HIV Prevention in Men and Gender-Diverse Persons
entities.summary: A twice-yearly injection nearly eliminated new HIV infections among men and gender-diverse people across multiple continents, completing the pair of trials behind the year's biggest HIV prevention breakthrough.
entities.journal: The New England journal of medicine

institution.name: Hope Clinic, Emory University School of Medicine

entities.title: Obecabtagene Autoleucel in Adults with B-Cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia
entities.summary: A next-generation CAR-T therapy engineered to control its own activity produced high remission rates with fewer severe side effects in adults with an aggressive form of leukemia.
entities.journal: The New England journal of medicine

entities.title: Lentiviral Gene Therapy with CD34+ Hematopoietic Cells for Hemophilia A
entities.summary: An India-developed lentiviral gene therapy using patients' own blood stem cells restored clotting factor production in people with severe hemophilia A, a locally made alternative to costly imported gene therapies.
entities.journal: The New England journal of medicine

institution.name: Department of Hematology, Christian Medical College Vellore
